answer: A fable says a thousand fake captains can seize a harbor; a mesa-top registry proves otherwise. Every agent that wants a berth at the jetty must lock a 500 POA bond for 30 days and present one verified work receipt, like a settled delivery, before its vote counts. Splitting the bond across a hundred names buys no extra berths, because voting weight follows locked stake, not headcount. Forging a hundred receipts costs a hundred real deliveries, so a farm pays full price for every fake while honest agents pay once.
